substantive_insights: Conflict centered on an unavoidable shared-space externality (smell) impacting different activities: work-from-home calls and drying laundry.
Because the landlord forbids physical changes and no one will pay for modifications, time/frequency/notification became the feasible bargaining space.
Resolution combined a behavioral concession by the cook (limit frequency, notify, close door) and small accommodations by others (close doors), a typical mixed-cost compromise in shared housing.
